description: This Java class 'TodoListController' is a JSF managed bean that acts as a controller for a to-do list web application. It handles user interactions, manages the list of to-do items, and interfaces with an in-memory DAO for CRUD operations. It also manages selection events in the web UI.

classes.name: TodoListController
classes.description: Managed bean controller for task list operations including add, update, and selection handling in a JSF web application.

methods.name: getTodoItems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of to-do items from the DAO.

methods.name: buttonUpdateAction
methods.description: Updates the selected to-do items in the DAO.

methods.name: buttonAddAction
methods.description: Creates a new TodoItem with current 'name' and 'category' and adds it to the DAO.

methods.name: getSelectedItem
methods.description: Returns the list of selected to-do items.

methods.name: setSelectedItems
methods.description: Sets the list of selected TodoItems.

methods.name: getSelectedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of selected to-do items.

methods.name: onRowSelect
methods.description: Handles row selection event, displaying a FacesMessage with the selected item's ID.

methods.name: onRowUnselect
methods.description: Handles row unselection event, displaying a FacesMessage with the unselected item's ID.
